query:
SELECT 
  c.name as coach_name,
  COUNT(s.id) as student_count,
  SUM(CAST(s.feePerQuarter AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_fee
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN coaches c ON s.coach_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name;
